headline: Raigeki
title: Raigeki Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Raigeki. What is it? It is a Normal Spell Card. What does it do? Destroy all monsters your opponent controls. How do you use it? Play it before you attack, then swing into an empty field. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
